see what's new

Check out our latest product releases.

Chaos Cosmos: A growing, smarter, and more connected asset library.

This September, Chaos Cosmos expands with 7,000+ new assets across people, vegetation, furniture, and accessories. With seamless integration across the Chaos ecosystem, including Enscape, Cosmos now delivers the right assets for both real-time design and photoreal rendering.

And with ongoing updates, from greater asset diversity to the new AI Material Generator, which transforms photos into realistic, usable materials — the library will keep growing, and getting smarter with every release.
Get started
V-Ray 7 for Cinema 4D, update 2

Create faster and enhance the realism of your renders in just a few clicks with V-Ray 7, update 2. Enjoy more realistic materials and better material workflows with the new material displacement and AI Material Generation. Easily create realistic people and vegetation using AI Enhancer, produce stunning night renders with the new Night Sky feature, and more.

Learn more >

Corona 14: Rendering reimagined

Corona 14 blends human creativity with AI intelligence, enhanced procedural power, and cosmic inspiration to deliver faster results and more emotional storytelling. Create your best work yet, with more detailed and realistic materials, environments, and atmospheric effects, using the new Gaussian splats support, Night Sky, Fabric Material, AI Material Generator, and more.

Learn more >

Real-time, right in your viewport, and more.

Chaos Vantage’s high-quality, real-time rendering is now available right in Maya and Houdini’s viewports via a new Hydra Delegate for Houdini and an enhanced Live Link for Maya, helping speed pre-production with instant, near–final-pixel quality feedback for layout, lookdev, previz, and animation previews. You’ll also find exciting new features across V-Ray for Maya, V-Ray for Houdini, and Chaos Vantage.

Learn more >

V-Ray for Blender, update 2 is here

Brings in macOS and Blender 5.0 support, plus AI-powered tools for image enhancement, material generation, and upscaling, making it easier than ever to create stunning, realistic, high-quality renders. Distributed rendering to speed up production, and more.

See all that’s new>
